|rulings=* When Light Force drains, Dark gets first optional response, and may cancel the drain (e.g. with [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]]), preventing Light from responding with a destiny draw attempt to liberate the system.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Restore%20Freedom%20To%20The%20Galaxy%20%28AI%29 Scomp: Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (AI)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* When Light liberates a system, the Force drain +1 bonus is immediately applied to the very same Force drain that triggered the liberation.
* When Dark Force drains, placing the stacked card in owner's Used Pile is an automatic response, occurring before optional responses such as Light using [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] or [[Blue Squadron 1]] to cancel the drain.
* If a player loses Force from hand to stack under a system, it is first revealed to both players, then stacked face down.
* If a player loses Force from Life Force to stack under a system, it is not revealed to anyone. Stack it face down, unseen.
* Only Dark may view Dark's cards after they are stacked face down under a system.
